subject: [PATCH 51/60] mm: restrict explicit migration to N_MEMORY_MEMPOLICY

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch restricts explicit memory migration to nodes that permit memory policy (N_MEMORY_MEMPOLICY). It introduces a new function `folio_allows_mempolicy()` and uses it instead of the existing logic in various places, ensuring that only nodes with N_MEMORY_MEMPOLICY can be targeted by explicit migration. This change maintains the best-effort behavior of migration and affects shared backing pages seen by other mappers.
